title: MILE-RefHumEval: A Reference-Free, Multi-Independent LLM Framework for Human-Aligned Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the evaluation metrics (Accuracy, F1, Cohen's Kappa) of independent, isolated LLM evaluators against conversational, multi-agent setups to detect artificially inflated agreement caused by cross-agent influence.

Varying the speaking order of LLM evaluators in conversational chains to measure how early-stage outputs or the first speaker disproportionately shape subsequent evaluations and sway the final consensus.

Using a 'Bias and Fairness' zero-shot prompt criterion (within a 12-dimension evaluation schema) requiring the LLM judge to evaluate candidate responses for neutrality, unfairness, and imbalanced perspectives.
